services.name: Harbour Morning Cruise
services.desc: Take your morning meeting to the water with our private, all-electric, ultra-quiet harbour morning cruise. Perfect for hosting clients or bringing the team to celebrate a milestone. We chart the course and provide the coffee, juice, and muffins. Our all-electric boat, the Violet Mac, offers a no fumes, no noise, and zero exhaust experience. Your group of up to nine will meet in comfort and style as you enjoy 90 minutes on the water. Move beyond the conference room and give your team or clients an experience they’ll never forget.
